name: Water Lilies
description: Monet painted the pond of his garden at Giverny again and again in his last years: no horizon, only water, light and reflections.

name: The Raft of the Medusa
description: The survivors of a real shipwreck of 1816, crowded on a makeshift raft, wave at a ship far away on the horizon.

name: Liberty Leading the People
description: A woman holding the French flag leads people over a barricade, during the July Revolution of 1830 in Paris.

name: The Gleaners
description: Three peasant women bend down to pick up the grains of wheat left in the field after the harvest.

name: The Thinker
description: A man sits deep in thought, his chin on his hand. Rodin first imagined him at the top of a huge door, The Gates of Hell.

name: Winged Victory of Samothrace
description: A goddess of victory lands on the prow of a ship, wings wide open, her dress pressed against her by the wind.
